reason: In AzureAISearchIndexManager.CreateAsync the refactor drops the 'await' on client.CreateIndexAsync(searchIndex), turning it into a fire-and-forget call whose exceptions/completion are no longer observed, which is a functional regression in index creation for this search provider.
